phase_convention: All three e_p(t)=sqrt(2)*grid_phase_rms_V*clip(t/ramp_s,0,1)*sin(2*pi*frequency_Hz*t+phase_p); one whole-triple plus-phase convention. Source ramp and angle use continuous electrical time, not held reference time.
electrical_integrator: trapezoidal; fixed h; no continuous switching-event relocation

topology.description: Three grounded-star AC sources, each followed by series R, L and native ideal phase ammeter, feed a complementary six-switch bridge. Floating ideal DC source joins its rails. The three native zero-impedance phase ammeters measure the same series branch currents; teaching needs16 electrical components and no added impedance. No DC ammeter or DC earth shunt.

directions.DC_absorbing_source_current: positive DC source NA to negative NB; negative of native ownBA current NB to NA
directions.DC_source_terminal_voltage: positive source terminal minus negative source terminal

topology.current_mapping: The three native ideal phase ammeter currents map to existing candidate series inductor branch currents, all AC-to-bridge. The direct native DC source current maps to candidate i:Vdc; no DC ammeter.

initial_conditions.electrical_initialization: Retain actual native zero-state initialization and solve; do not substitute the first positive-time sample or force measured leakage to zero.
